key_ideas.title: Transcript-First Filter (Zero-Byte Ingestion)
key_ideas.description: Scans linguistic stream first to determine high-entropy intervals before activating vision tokens.

key_ideas.title: Agentic Spatio-Temporal Zooming
key_ideas.description: Dynamic multi-scale frame sampling only at points of high architectural density (-88% token cost).

key_ideas.title: Continuous Memory Distillation into SCONES

actionable_takeaways: Use fetch_youtube_transcript as Level 0 pre-filter for all YouTube ingestion tasks.
Route complex video queries to Gemini 3.8 Agentic Video Understanding to keep token overhead <= 850 tokens.
Persist extracted ideas into SCONES FTS5 memory store for cross-agent architectural reuse.

benchmark.topic: Multi-Repo Agent Navigation & Home Repo Worktree Routing
benchmark.video_idea_evaluated: Home Repo pattern with AGENTS.md hyperlink routing and dynamic git worktrees for concurrent agents

corporate_benchmarks.architectural_pattern: Dynamic Subprocess Git Worktrees & Shadow Clones
key_tradeoffs: High file-system isolation per task turn
Requires automatic pruning of stale worktrees to prevent disk leaks
Seamless branch switching without touching developer working copy
corporate_benchmarks.scale_fit_for_dnk: Directly adaptable (aligns with APFS CoW & DEC-120)
corporate_benchmarks.primary_source: Cursor Agentic Specs & Cognition Devin Sandboxing 2026

corporate_benchmarks.architectural_pattern: CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md Path Pointers with Progressive LOD
key_tradeoffs: Zero context bloat: loads directory indexes only on explicit navigation
Fast cold-start (no monolithic repo index preload)
Fragile if sibling repository paths are renamed or moved

corporate_benchmarks.architectural_pattern: Sovereign CLI Hub with Isolated WASM / Function Targets
key_tradeoffs: Each satellite app is a standalone deployable unit
Centralized CLI orchestrator handles auth and synchronization
Enforces strict boundaries between core ledger and extensions
corporate_benchmarks.primary_source: Shopify Horizon CLI & Stripe System Architecture 2026

benchmark.winning_synthesis: As of 2026-11-17, the optimal architecture combines Matt Pocock's Home Repo entrypoint with Cursor/Devin's dynamic APFS git worktree isolation and Anthropic's progressive AGENTS.md routing. This avoids monolithic repo bloat while guaranteeing multi-agent parallel safety.
benchmark.dnk_sovereign_adaptation:
1. Bind swarm subagents (`workspace: 'share'`) strictly to isolated APFS `git worktree` sessions.
2. Expose external repo catalog (1,663 repos) via progressive 2-level Markdown routing in `docs/architecture/`.
3. Enforce Invariant 10: All foreign repositories remain quarantined in `../DNK_Vibe/`.
4. Wire all memory and knowledge lookups through SCONES FTS5 WAL and FastMCP microkernel (< 400 LOC).
